notes: Portable C++ primary and contract use only the IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador surfaces with an adapter-supplied provider, model FOM, endpoint, and callback model. A grandchild interaction is sent three times as base-only, base-plus-middle, and base-plus-middle-plus-exact subscriptions accumulate. Each send produces one callback at the closest subscribed class. Empty parameter maps isolate class selection; parameter filtering and independent-provider conformance are outside this case.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador getInteractionClassHandle, publishInteractionClass, subscribeInteractionClass, sendInteraction, and FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 interaction declaration and receive callback surfaces
